ns2:section.sectionText: In this advanced studio course, students will work in design teams to provide web development services (using WordPress) for campus and nonprofit local clients. Students will gain hands-on, professional experience in such areas as needs assessment (including client interviews), content strategy, journey mapping, information architecture, search engine optimization (SEO), use of AI tools, usability, and accessibility testing. This course is intended for graduate students or undergraduate students with junior or senior standing (2-3 credits for undergraduate students; 2-4 credits for graduate students).
